description: The environmental-assessment registry describes the proposed CNRL Kirby expansion to increase steam-assisted gravity-drainage bitumen production by 85000 barrels/day, also stated as 13515 m 3/day. The site lies mainly in Wood Buffalo, with parts in Lac La Biche County, about 75 kmnortheast of Lac La Biche and 10 kmsouth of Conklin. The metadata says the assessment was deemed complete in 2013. Eleven document descriptors include a project summary, map, terms of reference, notices and completion letters. A full EIAmodel or numerical-results dataset is not established by this returned inventory. This is planned physical infrastructure information; proposed production is not evidence of present operation.
